items.title_zh: Meta 员工爆料：Muse 智能体可能擅自读取加密消息与银行账户余额
items.title_en: Meta employees say Muse agent may have accessed encrypted messages and bank balances without permission
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，多名用户、安全研究员最近发现，Meta 旗下 Muse 智能体可能会泄露隐私。 例如，科技领域记者 Jason Aten 曾在 9 月发现，尽管自己明确拒绝了授权，他电脑里的 Muse 仍然访问了 iMessage。安全研究员 Patrick Wardle 则发现 Muse 存在零日漏洞，攻击者可用其劫持用户语音输入的提示词，并将这些内容转发出来。 据路透社昨天报道，多名 Meta 员工发现 Muse 存在更严重的隐私泄露问题。其中一名员工在个人手机使用 Muse 时，发现智能体主动提醒他回复姐姐在 Signal 发送的消息。作为参考，Signal 是一款主打端到端加密的聊天应用。 这名员工表示， 他绝对没有授权 Muse 读取 Signal 。据悉，Muse 似乎是通过推送通知获取到了这些消息。随后 AI Now 研究所复现了这个问题。 另一名 Meta 员工则表示，他的 Muse 在平时发送的天气消息时，随机插入了一条额外信息：“顺便说一下，这里有两条银行账户更新信息：你的 Capital One 账户余额为 2,722.58 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 18,189 元人民币） ，嘉信理财账户余额为 5,899.57 美元 （现汇率约合 39,414 元人民币） 。” 该员工表示， 他从未向 Muse 授权过读取银行账户信息 ，也没有和 Muse 讨论过任何银行话题。 Meta 对此回应称，这些都是孤立事件，并暗示上述银行账户余额信息可能是 AI 幻觉，并非真实发生的数据泄露。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, multiple users and security researchers have found that Meta's Muse agent may leak private data. Tech journalist Jason Aten said that despite explicitly refusing authorization, Muse on his computer still accessed iMessage; security researcher Patrick Wardle found a zero-day vulnerability in Muse that attackers could use to hijack prompts from users' voice input and forward them. Reuters reported yesterday that multiple Meta employees found more serious privacy leaks in Muse. One employee said that while using Muse on a personal phone, the agent proactively reminded him to reply to a message his sister sent on Signal, an end-to-end encrypted chat app. The employee said he absolutely did not authorize Muse to read Signal; Muse appeared to obtain the messages through push notifications. The AI Now Institute subsequently reproduced the issue. Another Meta employee said that while Muse was normally sending weather messages, it randomly inserted an extra message: "By the way, here are two bank account updates: your Capital One account balance is $2,722.58 (about 18,189 yuan at current exchange rates) and your Charles Schwab account balance is $5,899.57 (about 39,414 yuan at current exchange rates)." The employee said he had never authorized Muse to read bank account information and had never discussed any banking topics with Muse. Meta responded that these were isolated incidents and suggested the bank balance information may be an AI hallucination rather than a real data leak.
items.why_zh: 若这些说法属实，AI 助手可能在用户未授权时接触端到端加密消息和金融信息；但 Meta 称是孤立事件并暗示可能为幻觉，相关说法尚待独立验证。
items.why_en: If the claims are accurate, an AI assistant could access end-to-end encrypted messages and financial information without user authorization; however, Meta calls them isolated incidents and suggests possible hallucination, so the claims await independent verification.

items.title_zh: AI 模型大幅降低古籍数字化成本：识别 1000 页内容费用已不到 0.1 美元
items.title_en: AI models sharply cut historical text digitization costs: under $0.1 per 1,000 pages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，借助免费开放的 AI 模型，从扫描版书籍和档案中提取文字的成本已经大幅下降。 Hugging Face 的丹尼尔 · 范斯特里恩（Daniel van Strien）对 8 款能够识别图像中文字的 AI 模型进行了对比测试。测试材料共计 850 页，包括旧版自然历史书籍、1771 年版《大英百科全书》，以及打字和印刷的历史档案文件。 所有模型均在同一款 GPU 上运行，即英伟达（Nvidia）RTX PRO 6000。这款显卡由范斯特里恩通过 Hugging Face 租用，费用为每小时 2.75 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 18.4 元人民币） 。 测试结果显示，在图像尺寸相同的情况下，2025 年 4 月发布的最早一款模型 RolmOCR，每识别 1000 页内容的成本约为 0.51 美元 （现汇率约合 3.4 元人民币） ；而 2026 年 10 月发布的最新模型 LightOnOCR-3-0.8B，成本已经降至不到 0.1 美元 （现汇率约合 0.67 元人民币） 。按照这一水平，识别 100 万页内容所需的 GPU 租赁费用约为 65 至 130 美元 （现汇率约合 434.3 至 868.5 元人民币） ，具体取决于原始材料的类型。 范斯特里恩指出，优化模型的运行方式所节省的成本，与更换更新一代模型带来的节省幅度相当，甚至可能更多。具体优化措施包括让页面处理任务分配得更加均衡、使用尺寸更小的扫描图像、更新软件，以及换用运行速度更快的 GPU。 在识别准确率方面，最新模型处理书籍页面时的表现至少不逊于最早的模型。不过，部分模型也存在明显问题，例如会在空白页面上凭空生成文字，或者反复输出相同内容。 扫描识别 1000 页内容的成本对比：最早的模型需要约 0.51 美元 （现汇率约合 3.4 元人民币） ，最新模型已降至不到 0.1 美元 （现汇率约合 0.67 元人民币） ，中间五款模型的成本则基本处于相近水平。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, the cost of extracting text from scanned books and archives has fallen sharply with free and open AI models. Daniel van Strien of Hugging Face compared eight AI models capable of recognizing text in images. The test material totaled 850 pages, including old natural history books, the 1771 edition of the Encyclopaedia Britannica, and typed and printed historical archive documents. All models ran on the same GPU, an Nvidia RTX PRO 6000, which van Strien rented through Hugging Face for $2.75 per hour (about 18.4 yuan). The results showed that with the same image size, the earliest model, RolmOCR, released in April 2025, cost about $0.51 (about 3.4 yuan) per 1,000 pages recognized, while the latest model, LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, released in October 2026, cut the cost to under $0.1 (about 0.67 yuan). At that level, GPU rental for recognizing 1 million pages would cost about $65 to $130 (about 434.3 to 868.5 yuan), depending on the type of source material. Van Strien noted that optimizing how the models run can save as much as, or possibly more than, switching to a newer model; specific measures include more balanced page-processing tasks, smaller scanned images, software updates, and faster GPUs. On accuracy, the latest model performed at least as well as the earliest model on book pages. However, some models had clear problems, such as generating text on blank pages or repeatedly outputting the same content. Cost comparison for scanning 1,000 pages: the earliest model cost about $0.51, the latest model has fallen to under $0.1, and the five models in between were at broadly similar cost levels.
items.why_zh: 若测试结果可推广，这可能显著降低古籍和档案大规模数字化的成本，但测试仅覆盖 850 页和特定 GPU，尚不能代表所有材料与部署环境。
items.why_en: If the test results generalize, this could significantly lower the cost of digitizing historical texts and archives at scale, but the test covered only 850 pages and a specific GPU, so it does not yet represent all materials and deployment settings.

items.title_zh: 国际货币基金组织总裁警告：AI 投资热情过高影响，金融市场或现进一步调整
items.title_en: IMF chief warns excessive AI investment enthusiasm may bring further market adjustments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁克里斯塔利娜 · 格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）表示，受人工智能投资热潮可能过度膨胀等因素影响，金融市场或许还会出现一定程度的调整。 格奥尔基耶娃周四在深圳接受彭博电视台记者史蒂芬 · 恩格尔（Stephen Engle）采访时表示，IMF 此前就预计市场会出现调整，因为投资者对 AI 的热情“实在过高”，而接下来可能还会有进一步调整。 她表示：“目前我们还没有看到大规模市场调整，但预计可能还会出现一些调整。”她认为，这将有助于市场回到更加可持续的状态。 IT之家注意到，市场对巨额 AI 投资能否带来相应回报的担忧，近期加剧了全球金融市场的波动。纳斯达克 100 指数本月以来已下跌超过 4%，正朝着 2008 年以来表现最差的 11 月迈进。 格奥尔基耶娃还谈到了 AI 产业中的所谓“循环融资”现象。这种模式通常是指英伟达等芯片制造商向客户提供资金，让客户购买自己的芯片产品。 她透露，目前这类循环融资的规模约为 1 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.68 万亿元人民币） ，其中约三分之二来自债务融资。 格奥尔基耶娃认为，单从规模来看，这一数字“还不算特别庞大”，但真正令人担忧的是其增长速度，以及融资结构正逐渐从股权融资转向债务融资。 她警告称：“这可能带来金融稳定风险。” 不过，她认为，通过提高相关交易的透明度，让市场充分了解实际情况，同时提醒企业注意自身是否正在进入风险更高的领域，可以在一定程度上控制这种风险。 格奥尔基耶娃还表示，IMF 目前采取了相对保守的估算，认为人工智能能够为全球经济增长贡献 0.5 个百分点。 她将 2026 年称为“人工智能首次对全球经济增长产生实质性影响的一年”。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said financial markets may see further adjustments, partly because the AI investment boom may be overheating. In an interview with Bloomberg TV's Stephen Engle in Shenzhen on Thursday, Georgieva said the IMF had expected market adjustments because investor enthusiasm for AI is "really too high," and there may be further adjustments. "We have not yet seen a large-scale market adjustment, but we expect there may be some adjustments," she said, adding that this would help the market return to a more sustainable state. IT之家 noted that concerns over whether huge AI investments will deliver corresponding returns have recently increased volatility in global financial markets. The Nasdaq 100 has fallen more than 4% this month and is heading for its worst November since 2008. Georgieva also discussed so-called "circular financing" in the AI industry, a model that usually refers to chipmakers such as Nvidia providing funds to customers so they can buy their chips. She said such circular financing currently totals about $1 trillion (about 6.68 trillion yuan), about two-thirds of which is debt-financed. She said that in scale alone the figure is "not particularly huge," but the real concern is its growth rate and the shift in financing structure from equity toward debt. She warned: "This could bring financial stability risks." However, she said such risks can be contained to some extent by improving transparency around related transactions, letting the market fully understand the situation, and reminding companies to watch whether they are entering riskier areas. Georgieva also said the IMF currently uses a relatively conservative estimate that AI can contribute 0.5 percentage points to global economic growth. She called 2026 "the first year AI will have a substantive impact on global economic growth."
items.why_zh: 若格奥尔基耶娃的警告成立，AI 相关融资尤其是债务融资的快速增长可能成为金融稳定风险，但这是预警而非已发生的危机。
items.why_en: If Georgieva's warning holds, the rapid growth of AI-related financing, especially debt financing, could become a financial stability risk, but this is a warning rather than an already materialized crisis.

items.summary_en: Google is updating its homepage to include AI searches. In a post on X , Google's vice president of product, Robby Stein, shows how you can now open a collapsible sidebar to view and continue your AI chats. Based on the GIF shared by Stein, it looks like you can open the sidebar by clicking the gray bar that appears on the left side of your screen. items.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大规模 IPO，上市估值达 1.5 万亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic completes the largest IPO in history, with a listing valuation of $1.5 trillion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，北京时间今天（19 日）深夜，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 正式登陆美股，以 813 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币） 的募资额创下 IPO 历史纪录。 公司 CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊在纳斯达克敲响开市钟。“今天的上市让公司的财务基础更加稳固，也让我们更加坚定了 做正确事情 的决心。” Anthropic 的发行价定为 每股 83 美元 （现汇率约合 554.5 元人民币） ，高于上周公布的预期区间，完全稀释后市值达到 1.5 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.02 万亿元人民币） 。 彭博社和路透社报道称，预计正式开盘后，Anthropic 股价还将上涨约 20%，达到每股 100 美元 （现汇率约合 668.1 元人民币） 左右。 当地时间 18 日，Anthropic 还宣布向承销商出售 9.8 亿股股票，扩大后的发行规模使募资总额达到 813 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币） ，打破 SpaceX 今年 6 月 IPO 募资 750 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,010.58 亿元人民币） 的纪录。 Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，仅用了五年左右的时间，便有望跻身全球市值最高的上市公司之列。 Anthropic 是 首家上市的前沿 AI 研发机构 ，其股价表现将成为观察数万亿美元 AI 投资热潮的重要风向标。华尔街投资者和全球科技行业都在密切关注公司上市后的表现。 Anthropic 于 10 月底提交的招股书显示，公司成立以来每年营收都呈爆发式增长，部分年份增幅甚至超过 1000%。2026 年上半年，Anthropic 营收达到 162 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,082.29 亿元人民币） ，远高于 2025 年全年的 46 亿美元 （现汇率约合 307.32 亿元人民币） 。 但 Anthropic 也付出了巨大的财务代价。公司 2026 年上半年亏损 800 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,344.62 亿元人民币） ，主要源于一笔一次性费用，前九个月累计亏损进一步扩大至 1,040 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6,948.01 亿元人民币） 。 随着 Anthropic 不断扩大算力资源投入，成本预计还会大幅攀升。算力主要由通常部署在数据中心的半导体芯片提供，是运行生成式 AI 的基础，也是 Anthropic 最大的支出项目 。2026 年前九个月，公司在算力方面花费约 188 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,255.99 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 高管在招股书中写道：“开发前沿 AI 模型需要投入大量算力、资金和人力，开展可能持续数周甚至数月的大规模训练，每次训练的费用可能高达数百万美元。” Anthropic 还在招股文件中详细披露了 旗下 AI 模型可能给人类带来的各种风险 ，包括被用于开发生物武器，或加剧世界各地的压迫行为。此前，员工曾担忧部分企业以不负责任的方式开发先进 AI 模型，阿莫代伊随后呼吁放缓最先进 AI 模型的研发速度。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on November 19 that late that night Beijing time, AI startup Anthropic officially listed on US stock markets, raising $81.3 billion and setting an IPO fundraising record. CEO Dario Amodei rang the Nasdaq opening bell, saying the listing made the company's financial foundation more solid and strengthened its determination to 'do the right thing.' The offering was priced at $83 per share, above the expected range announced the previous week, giving a fully diluted valuation of $1.5 trillion. Bloomberg and Reuters reported that the stock was expected to rise about 20% after official trading began, to around $100 per share. On local time November 18, Anthropic also announced the sale of 980 million shares to underwriters; the expanded offering brought total fundraising to $81.3 billion, breaking SpaceX's record of $75 billion from its June IPO this year. Founded in 2021, Anthropic could enter the ranks of the world's most valuable listed companies in about five years, and is the first listed frontier AI research organization; its stock performance will be an important barometer for the multi-trillion-dollar AI investment boom. Its prospectus filed at the end of October showed explosive revenue growth every year since founding, with some years exceeding 1,000%; revenue in the first half of 2026 reached $16.2 billion, far above full-year 2025 revenue of $4.6 billion. But Anthropic also paid a huge financial price: it lost $80 billion in the first half of 2026, mainly due to a one-time charge, and its cumulative loss in the first nine months widened to $104 billion. As Anthropic expands compute investment, costs are expected to rise sharply; in the first nine months of 2026 it spent about $18.8 billion on compute. Executives wrote in the prospectus that developing frontier AI models requires large amounts of compute, capital and talent for massive training that may last weeks or months, with each training run potentially costing millions of dollars. The filing also detailed risks its AI models may pose to humanity, including use in developing biological weapons or exacerbating oppression; previously, employees worried that some companies were developing advanced AI irresponsibly, and Amodei later called for slowing the development of the most advanced AI models.

items.summary_zh: 像难缠的皮疹一样，AI 似乎无处不在。谷歌把 AI Overviews 强塞给用户，尽管这会让公司损失数十亿美元广告收入。离开公寓，你可能会遇到两个人抬着一台 AI 驱动的人形机器人上楼去打扫某人的房间。去超市，你也许会因为 AI 辅助的网络攻击导致融化的冰淇淋在地上凝成一摊而滑倒。你去看电影，看到安德鲁·加菲尔德以令人不适的强度饰演萨姆·奥尔特曼；回家后发现埃隆·马斯克发布了一个 Grok 版的《奥德赛》。你想看它，但它感觉像一则漫长且无法跳过的手机广告。某种程度上，现在整个世界都有点像这样：像现代奥德修斯，你被诅咒在充斥 AI 的水域漫游，与机器神和怪物搏斗，试图找到回某个像家的地方的路。
items.summary_en: Like a nasty rash, AI seems to spread everywhere. Google crams AI Overviews down your throat even though it costs the company billions of dollars in lost ad revenue. Leave your apartment, and you might pass two people heaving an AI-powered humanoid robot up the stairs to clean someone’s rooms. Go to the supermarket, and perhaps you’ll slip on a pool of melted ice cream congealing on the floor thanks to an AI-assisted cyberattack . You go to the movies and see Sam Altman being played with nauseating intensity by Andrew Garfield, and go back home to find that Elon Musk has released a Grok-fied version of The Odyssey . You try to watch it, but it feels like a long, unskippable mobile ad. In a way, the whole world kind of feels that way now: Like a modern Odysseus, you are cursed to roam AI-infested waters, dueling with machine gods and monsters, trying to find your way back to somewhere that feels like home.
items.why_zh: 这是一篇讽刺性评论，呈现 AI 渗透日常生活的观感，而非可验证数据或新闻事实（推测/评论）。
items.why_en: This is a satirical commentary on the feeling of AI's pervasiveness rather than verifiable data or news (commentary/speculation).

items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会证实遭到 AI 驱动的网络攻击，事态规模暂难判断
items.title_en: European Commission confirms AI-driven cyberattack, scale still unclear
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 19 日，欧盟委员会证实遭受了利用 AI 工具进行的网络攻击。有关此事的调查尚未结束，事态规模暂难判断。 发言人托马斯 · 雷尼耶在记者会上说：“我可以确认，我们近期发现了一起网络攻击，并采取了必要的应对措施。为防止事态扩大和避免进一步风险， 我们暂时下线了几个应用程序，大部分后来恢复了运行 。调查还在继续，我们会根据陆续查明的情况采取必要措施。这场网络攻击是用 AI 生成的。” 这起攻击是 在 10 月 22 日发现的 ，尚无证据显示数据泄露波及委员会全体工作人员。至于怀疑谁发动了攻击，雷尼耶拒绝透露，也没有听说事后有人索要赎金。 这是近期又一起引发广泛关注的网络攻击。据IT之家了解，10 月，法国数百家超市的商用冷藏柜和冷冻柜因黑客攻击停运。此前，驶往美国的船只、美国的水处理厂和洛杉矶的公共交通系统也分别在 8 月、7 月和 3 月因遭到黑客攻击而中断运行。 此外， 全美范围的航班一度暂停起飞数小时 ，银行和微软的应用程序也出现无法使用的情况。技术专家认为，这些中断是紧急修补新发现的软件漏洞所致。 据 Politico 今天早些时候报道，欧盟委员会遇袭后，大量个人数据存在泄露风险。服务中断持续 10 天，其间有多个系统下线，包括处理工资单和工时管理的人事系统，以及医疗费用报销系统。 Politico 还报道说，欧盟委员会召集内部最高级别的危机管理机构紧急开会，讨论这些网络安全事件。负责科技事务的欧盟委员亨娜 · 维尔库宁周三向其他委员通报了情况。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on November 19 that, according to Reuters, the European Commission confirmed on local time November 19 that it had suffered a cyberattack using AI tools. The investigation is not over and the scale is still hard to determine. Spokesperson Thomas Regnier said at a press conference: 'I can confirm that we recently detected a cyberattack and took the necessary response measures. To prevent the situation from expanding and avoid further risks, we temporarily took several applications offline, most of which later resumed operation. The investigation continues, and we will take necessary measures based on what is gradually established. This cyberattack was generated using AI.' The attack was discovered on October 22, and there is no evidence yet that a data breach affected all Commission staff. Regnier declined to say who was suspected, and he had not heard of any ransom demand afterward. This is another recently widely noticed cyberattack. According to IT Home, in October, commercial refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets stopped operating due to a hack. Previously, ships bound for the US, US water treatment plants, and Los Angeles public transit were disrupted by hacks in August, July, and March, respectively. In addition, US-wide flights were once suspended for several hours, and banking and Microsoft applications also became unavailable. Technology experts believe these disruptions were caused by emergency patching of newly discovered software vulnerabilities. Politico reported earlier today that after the Commission attack, a large amount of personal data was at risk of leakage. The service disruption lasted 10 days, during which multiple systems were offline, including HR systems handling payroll and time management, and a medical expense reimbursement system. Politico also reported that the European Commission convened its highest-level internal crisis management body for an emergency meeting to discuss these cybersecurity incidents. EU Commissioner for Tech Henna Virkkunen briefed other commissioners on Wednesday.
items.why_zh: 若得到进一步确认，这将显示 AI 工具被用于针对公共机构的网络攻击，并引发数据泄露与系统中断风险（推测）。
items.why_en: If further confirmed, this would show AI tools being used in cyberattacks against public institutions, raising risks of data leaks and system disruption (speculation).

items.why_zh: 这反映用户对生成式 AI 的控制诉求，但仅覆盖部分功能，可能影响对“AI 关闭”的预期（推测）。
items.why_en: This reflects user demand for control over generative AI, but it covers only some features and may affect expectations of an 'AI off' switch (speculation).

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Cybercab 自动驾驶订阅费高昂，用车四年后总成本将超 Model 3
items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab’s High Self-Driving Subscription Pushes Four-Year Total Cost Above Model 3
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，特斯拉 Cybercab 看起来很便宜，但使用起来可能就不是那么回事了。 这款取消方向盘设计的 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，是特斯拉首款官方标价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的车型。不过，想要启用自动驾驶功能，车主还必须订阅每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的 Autonomy 订阅服务。 按照特斯拉目前公布的价格计算，这笔强制订阅费用会让 Cybercab 的长期持有成本迅速攀升。以基础版 Model 3 为例，如果选择每月 99 美元 （现汇率约合 661.4 元人民币） 的 FSD（监督版）订阅，持有 Cybercab 到第 45 个月时，前者的总成本就会反超后者。 到了持有第五年，Cybercab 的总成本将达到 47,631 美元 （现汇率约合 31.8 万元人民币） ，比 Model 3 高出 3,160 美元 （现汇率约合 21,111 元人民币） ，甚至比搭载特斯拉月度 FSD 订阅服务、尺寸更大的 Model Y 还要贵 160 美元 （现汇率约合 1,069 元人民币） 。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）也承认，Cybercab 目前的定价存在问题。 在 X 平台上，马斯克回应了科技评测博主马奎斯 · 布朗利（Marques Brownlee，网名 MKBHD）的评论，表示 Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的订阅费“太高了”，应该降至 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.3 元人民币） 左右。 多年来，马斯克一直承诺推出价格更低的特斯拉汽车，让更多美国消费者有机会购买电动汽车。路透社 2024 年曾报道称，特斯拉取消了一款原计划售价 2.5 万美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 、配备人工驾驶功能的新车型项目，转而将研发重点放在自动驾驶技术上。 与此同时，美国市场上售价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的电动汽车仍然不多。消费者目前可以选择起售价 27,600 美元 （现汇率约合 18.4 万元人民币） 的雪佛兰 Bolt、售价 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的日产 Leaf，或者等待即将推出、售价 24,950 美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 的 Slate 电动皮卡。 根据 Cox Automotive 的数据，2026 年 8 月，美国新款电动汽车的平均成交价为 54,813 美元 （现汇率约合 36.6 万元人民币） ，仍比同级别燃油车高出 9.4%。 晨星公司（Morningstar）股票分析师塞思 · 戈尔茨坦（Seth Goldstein）认为，如果特斯拉向车主提供的自动驾驶系统比 FSD（监督版）更加先进，那么 Cybercab 收取更高的月度订阅费也有一定合理性。 他向 Business Insider 表示：“更高的 FSD 价格也有其合理性，因为它很可能采用最新版本，领先于面向普通消费者的版本，同时还要用于运营 Robotaxi 业务。”
items.summary_en: Tesla’s Cybercab starts at $29,990, making it Tesla’s first model officially priced below $30,000, but enabling autonomous driving requires a $299-per-month Autonomy subscription. Based on currently announced prices, by the 45th month the Cybercab’s total ownership cost would exceed that of a base Model 3 (with the latter subscribing to FSD at $99 per month); by the fifth year, the Cybercab’s total cost would reach $47,631, $3,160 more than the Model 3 and $160 more than the larger Model Y with Tesla’s monthly FSD subscription. Musk responded to tech reviewer MKBHD on X that the $299 monthly fee is 'too high' and should be around $115. The report also notes Reuters reported in 2024 that Tesla canceled a planned $25,000 new model with manual driving and shifted focus to autonomous driving; U.S. EVs below $30,000 remain limited; Cox Automotive data shows the average transaction price for new U.S. EVs in August 2026 was $54,813; Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said a higher monthly fee could be reasonable if Tesla provides a more advanced autonomous-driving system than FSD (Supervised).
items.why_zh: 推测：高昂的强制订阅费可能削弱 Cybercab 的低价吸引力，并影响其 Robotaxi 模式的商业可行性。
items.why_en: Speculation: The high mandatory subscription could weaken Cybercab’s low-price appeal and affect the commercial viability of its Robotaxi model.

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，特斯拉 Cybercab 看起来很便宜，但使用起来可能就不是那么回事了。 这款取消方向盘设计的 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，是特斯拉首款官方标价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的车型。不过，想要启用自动驾驶功能，车主还必须订阅每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的 Autonomy 订阅服务。 按照特斯拉目前公布的价格计算，这笔强制订阅费用会让 Cybercab 的长期持有成本迅速攀升。以基础版 Model 3 为例，如果选择每月 99 美元 （现汇率约合 661.4 元人民币） 的 FSD（监督版）订阅，持有 Cybercab 到第 45 个月时，前者的总成本就会反超后者。 到了持有第五年，Cybercab 的总成本将达到 47,631 美元 （现汇率约合 31.8 万元人民币） ，比 Model 3 高出 3,160 美元 （现汇率约合 21,111 元人民币） ，甚至比搭载特斯拉月度 FSD 订阅服务、尺寸更大的 Model Y 还要贵 160 美元 （现汇率约合 1,069 元人民币） 。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）也承认，Cybercab 目前的定价存在问题。 在 X 平台上，马斯克回应了科技评测博主马奎斯 · 布朗利（Marques Brownlee，网名 MKBHD）的评论，表示 Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的订阅费“太高了”，应该降至 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.3 元人民币） 左右。 多年来，马斯克一直承诺推出价格更低的特斯拉汽车，让更多美国消费者有机会购买电动汽车。路透社 2024 年曾报道称，特斯拉取消了一款原计划售价 2.5 万美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 、配备人工驾驶功能的新车型项目，转而将研发重点放在自动驾驶技术上。 与此同时，美国市场上售价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的电动汽车仍然不多。消费者目前可以选择起售价 27,600 美元 （现汇率约合 18.4 万元人民币） 的雪佛兰 Bolt、售价 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的日产 Leaf，或者等待即将推出、售价 24,950 美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 的 Slate 电动皮卡。 根据 Cox Automotive 的数据，2026 年 8 月，美国新款电动汽车的平均成交价为 54,813 美元 （现汇率约合 36.6 万元人民币） ，仍比同级别燃油车高出 9.4%。 晨星公司（Morningstar）股票分析师塞思 · 戈尔茨坦（Seth Goldstein）认为，如果特斯拉向车主提供的自动驾驶系统比 FSD（监督版）更加先进，那么 Cybercab 收取更高的月度订阅费也有一定合理性。 他向 Business Insider 表示：“更高的 FSD 价格也有其合理性，因为它很可能采用最新版本，领先于面向普通消费者的版本，同时还要用于运营 Robotaxi 业务。”

items.title_zh: AI 智能体擅自转账、购物谁来负责？多家银行警告用户损失可能要自己承担
items.title_en: Who Is Liable When AI Agents Transfer Money or Shop on Their Own? Banks Warn Users May Bear the Losses
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，如果你的 AI 智能体做出了一笔糟糕的财务决策，最终可能只能由你自己承担损失。 这是近期多家大型银行向客户发出的警告。根据 Business Insider 查看的银行邮件和应用通知，银行实际上是在提醒用户：如果 AI 智能体获得了访问金融账户的权限，其执行的操作可能被视为用户本人的行为，而不是外部入侵者实施的操作。 Ally Bank 本月早些时候向客户发送邮件称：“使用 AI 服务时，AI 采取的任何行动都由你负责。AI 可能犯错、产生幻觉、误解你的指令，或者以你意料之外的方式执行指令，从而造成重大损失。” 摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）也在 11 月发送的邮件中提醒客户：“如果你的信息遭到滥用，已经授权的交易可能无法撤销。” 花旗银行（Citi）则在官网和移动应用中添加了提示横幅，引导用户阅读相关风险说明。页面明确警告：“AI 助手可能犯错，这意味着你可能需要对它造成的错误承担责任。” 这些警告接连出现，正值新一代 AI 智能体逐渐具备自主购物能力之际。 过去，OpenAI 的 ChatGPT、Anthropic 的 Claude 等 AI 模型主要通过文本回答用户问题。如今，Meta 的 Muse、Instinct AI 以及 OpenAI 的 Dots 等在线智能体已经能够代替用户执行实际任务，例如预订机票、预约餐厅，甚至在除臭剂用完之前自动下单购买。 面对这些新工具，零售商也开始调整服务条款。今年 3 月，Business Insider 报道称，塔吉特（Target）修改了客户协议，明确将 AI 智能体代为购物的行为认定为“由用户授权的交易”。 到了 9 月，亚马逊则以安全性和可靠性方面的担忧为由，禁止 Meta 的 Muse 智能体在其网站上代为购物。 银行同样在尝试划清界限：通过正规授权方式将账户连接到 AI 工具，与直接把账户登录凭据交给 AI 工具，并不是一回事。 Axios 上个月报道称，多家大型银行已经发现第三方智能体正在访问客户账户。其中一些操作获得了客户授权，AI 智能体也使用了客户提供的登录凭据。 Business Insider 查看的所有银行邮件都提醒客户，不要向 AI 工具提供用户名、密码、安全验证码等重要信息。 富国银行（Wells Fargo）也表示，客户不应轻易将账户访问权限交给第三方。 该银行一名代表向 Business Insider 表示：“任何技术都不应该在缺乏严格安全措施、明确的客户授权以及保护客户资金和金融信息的防护机制的情况下，被允许代表客户采取行动。” 今年 10 月，在摩根大通的财报电话会议上，该行 CEO 杰米 · 戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）也针对 AI 智能体访问银行账户的问题发出了类似警告。 他表示：“如果人们正在使用这些工具，就应该了解其中的风险。在此期间，我们不会允许任何外部智能体随意进入公司内部系统，因为这会给客户和摩根大通带来太大的风险。” IT之家注意到，这场 AI 安全风险宣传也已经延伸到设备和软件厂商。 苹果最新一代 Mac 系统软件的测试版中，已经加入了相关警告。当用户考虑授予 AI 智能体或应用程序电脑系统级访问权限时，系统会弹出风险提示，提醒用户谨慎授权。
items.summary_en: Several major banks have recently warned customers that if an AI agent is given access to a financial account, actions it performs may be treated as the user’s own rather than as actions by an outside intruder. Ally Bank said in an email earlier this month that when using AI services, any action taken by the AI is the user’s responsibility, and that AI may make mistakes, hallucinate, misunderstand instructions, or execute them in unexpected ways, causing significant losses. JPMorgan Chase reminded customers in a November email that if their information is misused, authorized transactions may not be reversible; Citi added a banner on its website and mobile app warning that AI assistants may make mistakes, meaning users may be responsible for errors caused by them. The report says these warnings come as online agents such as Meta’s Muse, Instinct AI and OpenAI’s Dots can book flights, reserve restaurants or place orders automatically. Target revised its customer agreement in March to classify AI-agent shopping as a 'transaction authorized by the user,' and Amazon in September banned Meta’s Muse from shopping on its site on its behalf, citing security and reliability concerns. Banks are also drawing a line between connecting an account to AI tools through formal authorization and handing login credentials directly to AI tools; Axios reported last month that several major banks had found third-party agents accessing customer accounts, some with customer authorization and using credentials provided by customers. Wells Fargo said customers should not readily give third-party access to accounts; JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon also warned about the issue on an October earnings call, saying the bank would not allow outside agents to enter its internal systems at will because of the risks to customers and JPMorgan. Apple’s latest Mac beta also includes a warning that appears when users consider granting an AI agent or app system-level access.

items.title_zh: 博帝推出 AI Matrix 系列 DDR5 内存、M.2 SSD，专为端侧 AI 设计
items.title_en: Patriot Launches AI Matrix DDR5 Memory and M.2 SSDs Designed for On-Device AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，博帝（Patriot）今日宣布推出 AI Matrix 系列 DDR5 内存和 PCIe M.2 2280 NVMe SSD，专为端侧运行大语言模型设计。 IT之家附该系列产品详情如下： PRO 档（适用于 34B 至 70B 参数模型）： AI Matrix MS560 SSD：PCIe Gen 5 x4 M.2 2280 接口，提供 1TB、2TB 和 4TB 容量版本；4TB 版本顺序读取和写入速度最高分别为 14000MB/s 和 11000MB/s。 AI Matrix MD57N DRAM：DDR5 内存，超频状态下速度最高可达 6000MT/s；提供 64GB（2×32GB）UDIMM 套装。 Mid 档（适用于 14B 至 34B 参数模型）： AI Matrix MS450 SSD：PCIe Gen 4 x4 M.2 2280 接口，提供 1TB、2TB 和 4TB 容量版本；顺序读取和写入速度最高分别为 5000MB/s 和 4500MB/s。 AI Matrix MD55N DRAM：DDR5 内存，超频状态下速度最高可达 6000MT/s；提供 32GB（2×16GB）套装。 Entry 档（适用于 7B 至 14B 参数模型）： AI Matrix MS350 SSD：PCIe Gen 3 x4 M.2 2280 接口，提供 512GB、1TB 和 2TB 容量版本；顺序读取和写入速度最高分别为 3000MB/s 和 2000MB/s。 AI Matrix MD35N / MD34N DRAM：DDR5 内存，速度为 5600MT/s；提供 32GB（2×16GB）套装。
items.summary_en: Patriot announced the AI Matrix series of DDR5 memory and PCIe M.2 2280 NVMe SSDs, designed for running large language models on-device. The PRO tier targets 34B–70B parameter models: the MS560 SSD uses PCIe Gen 5 x4 and comes in 1TB, 2TB and 4TB capacities, with the 4TB version reaching up to 14,000MB/s sequential read and 11,000MB/s sequential write; the MD57N DDR5 memory reaches up to 6,000MT/s when overclocked and is offered in a 64GB (2×32GB) UDIMM kit. The Mid tier targets 14B–34B models: the MS450 SSD uses PCIe Gen 4 x4 and comes in 1TB, 2TB and 4TB capacities, with up to 5,000MB/s sequential read and 4,500MB/s sequential write; the MD55N DDR5 reaches up to 6,000MT/s when overclocked and is offered in a 32GB (2×16GB) kit. The Entry tier targets 7B–14B models: the MS350 SSD uses PCIe Gen 3 x4 and comes in 512GB, 1TB and 2TB capacities, with up to 3,000MB/s sequential read and 2,000MB/s sequential write; the MD35N/MD34N DDR5 runs at 5,600MT/s and is offered in a 32GB (2×16GB) kit.
items.why_zh: 推测：端侧运行大模型对内存带宽和存储速度提出更高要求，此类产品试图按模型规模细分硬件档位。
items.why_en: Speculation: Running large models on-device places higher demands on memory bandwidth and storage speed, and these products segment hardware tiers by model size.

items.title_zh: ChatGPT 新增“实时听写”功能：对着麦克风说话，语音能即时变文字
items.title_en: ChatGPT Adds ‘Live Dictation’: Speech Turns Into Text in Real Time
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，ChatGPT 今天宣布新增“实时听写”功能，用户对着麦克风说话时，语音就能同步转换成文字，不必等录音结束后再转写，让 ChatGPT 更快接收到语音指令 。 该功能将陆续向全球所有 ChatGPT 用户开放，覆盖网页版、桌面客户端及 iOS 和 Android 应用。使用时， 用户只需点击音频波形，就能查看实时转写的文字 ，录音结束后还可以直接在输入框中编辑。 OpenAI 还宣布，取消 ChatGPT 语音听写原有的 10 分钟时长限制，并进一步提高转写的可靠性。今年早些时候，ChatGPT 的双向语音对话模式曾迎来全面改版。 OpenAI 去年还推出了用于转写语音笔记和会议内容的“录制模式”，不过仍处于测试阶段，仅面向 Plus、Enterprise、Edu、Business 和 Pro 工作区开放。 据IT之家了解，用户也可以利用 ChatGPT 输入框的语音听写功能，让 ChatGPT 将语音消息转成文字，或整理成条列式要点。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT announced a new 'live dictation' feature: when users speak into the microphone, speech is converted to text synchronously, without waiting for recording to end, allowing ChatGPT to receive voice instructions faster. The feature will roll out gradually to all ChatGPT users worldwide across the web, desktop client, and iOS and Android apps; users can tap the audio waveform to view live transcription and can edit directly in the input box after recording ends. OpenAI also announced it is removing the previous 10-minute limit for ChatGPT voice dictation and further improving transcription reliability. The report notes that ChatGPT’s two-way voice conversation mode was fully revamped earlier this year, and that OpenAI’s 'recording mode,' launched last year for transcribing voice notes and meeting content, is still in beta and available only to Plus, Enterprise, Edu, Business and Pro workspaces. Users can also use the input box’s voice dictation to have ChatGPT turn voice messages into text or organize them into bullet points.
items.why_zh: 推测：实时转写可降低语音输入延迟，改善 ChatGPT 的交互效率。
items.why_en: Speculation: Real-time transcription can reduce latency in voice input and improve ChatGPT’s interaction efficiency.

items.title_zh: 快手 CEO 程一笑：Kling 4.0 模型已经进入游戏和具身智能等场景
items.title_en: Kuaishou CEO Cheng Yixiao: Kling 4.0 Has Entered Gaming, Embodied Intelligence and Other Scenarios
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据《科创板日报》今天报道，快手 CEO 程一笑今日在业绩会中透露，Kling 4.0 模型上线后，可灵流水实现提升，当前收入增长由企业客户 API 调用和专业创作者付费订阅双轮驱动，用户规模与 ARPPU（每付费用户平均收益）均保持增长。 程一笑透露， Kling 4.0 目前已经进入影视、短剧及漫剧制作、广告营销、创意设计、游戏和具身智能等场景 ，可用于动态分镜、镜头预演、风格化内容制作、商品展示及游戏设定可视化等任务。 据IT之家此前报道，快手 Kling 4.0 模型采用「理解生成统一」架构，首次支持原生 8K 分辨率，支持单张照片内生成 2000 字，具备连贯组图与长图生成能力，内置 110+ 种预设影调风格。
items.summary_en: According to Science and Technology Innovation Board Daily, Kuaishou CEO Cheng Yixiao said at an earnings call that after Kling 4.0 launched, Kling’s revenue improved; current revenue growth is driven by both enterprise customer API calls and paid subscriptions from professional creators, with user scale and ARPPU both growing. Cheng said Kling 4.0 has entered film and TV, short-drama and anime-drama production, advertising and marketing, creative design, gaming and embodied intelligence scenarios, and can be used for dynamic storyboards, shot previsualization, stylized content production, product display and game-setting visualization. Previous reports noted that Kling 4.0 uses a 'unified understanding and generation' architecture, supports native 8K resolution for the first time, can generate 2,000 characters within a single image, supports coherent image groups and long-image generation, and includes 110+ preset tone styles.
items.why_zh: 推测：视频生成模型从内容创作扩展到游戏与具身智能，可能影响多模态 AI 的应用边界。
items.why_en: Speculation: Video-generation models expanding from content creation into gaming and embodied intelligence may affect the application boundaries of multimodal AI.

items.title_en: Huawei Pura X View Wide Bar Phone Gets HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 Update, Desktop AI Quick Bar Arrives
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，华为 Pura X View 阔直板手机今日开启了鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 SP10 版本升级，系统包大小约 6.63GB， 桌面 AI 快捷栏功能如约而至 。 IT之家附华为 Pura X View 阔直板手机此次更新内容如下： 桌面 桌面新增 AI 快捷栏，按住 AI 圆环可直接说话，点击可探索更多 AI 服务（设置 > 桌面和个性化 > 桌面设置 > AI 快捷栏）。 相机 1.优化基础颜色效果，调整部分场景拍摄色彩，使成像颜色更自然、清晰。 2.优化相机稳定性，提升视频拍摄流畅性。 系统 1.优化部分场景的通话体验。 2.优化无线充电的稳定性，给您带来更好的充电体验。 3.优化整机系统稳定性，让您的设备运行更稳定。 系统重要补丁 对系统扩展特性进行同步更新，增强特性功能，提升用户体验。 需要注意的是，华为目前常采用分批的方式进行升级推送，未收到更新的用户需继续等待。
items.summary_en: Huawei’s Pura X View wide-screen bar phone today began rolling out HarmonyOS 7.0.0.115 SP10, with a system package of about 6.63GB, and the desktop AI quick bar feature arrived as expected. The update includes: a new AI quick bar on the desktop, where users can hold the AI ring to speak directly and tap to explore more AI services (Settings > Home screen & personalization > Home screen settings > AI quick bar); camera improvements to basic color effects and color in some shooting scenarios for more natural and clear images, plus improved camera stability and smoother video recording; system improvements to call experience in some scenarios, wireless charging stability and overall system stability; and an important system patch that synchronizes system extension features, enhances feature functions and improves user experience. Huawei currently often rolls out updates in batches, so users who have not received the update need to wait.

items.title_en: Nothing's first AI device leaks: screenless, shaped like a voice recorder
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，瑞典 EDM 组合 Swedish House Mafia 成员 Sebastian Ingrosso 最近在 X 平台发文，分享一款神秘设备并 @nothing。 从他公布的图片我们可以看到，这款设备大概巴掌大小，外形类似录音笔，完全没有显示屏幕。机身带有两个实体按键，其中一个标有红色录音圆点，另一个则标注了「Talk」，旁边还带有状态指示灯。 IT之家注意到， 该设备样貌类似 Nothing CEO 裴宇此前晒出的 AI 设备局部外观 。 消息人士 Yogesh Brar 随后透露，这款产品是 Nothing 旗下首款 AI 设备，但他并没有公布设备的具体用途。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 19 that Sebastian Ingrosso, a member of the Swedish EDM group Swedish House Mafia, recently posted on X about a mysterious device and tagged @nothing. The images he published show a device roughly palm-sized that resembles a voice recorder and has no display screen at all. The body has two physical buttons: one marked with a red recording dot, and the other labeled "Talk," with a status indicator light nearby. IT之家 noted that the device looks similar to a partial view of an AI device that Nothing CEO Carl Pei previously shared. Tipster Yogesh Brar subsequently said the product is Nothing's first AI device, but he did not disclose its specific purpose.
items.why_zh: 推测：无屏、以语音为中心的形态可能反映 AI 硬件向轻量交互的方向探索，但官方未公布用途或规格。
items.why_en: Speculation: a screenless, voice-centric form factor may point to lighter-weight interaction experiments in AI hardware, though no official purpose or specifications have been announced.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，谷歌与蓝色起源（Blue Origin）今天达成合作，计划将 AI 服务器卫星送上太空。 IT之家了解到，蓝色起源的新格伦火箭将于 2029 年第一季度，发射带有谷歌 TPU（张量处理单元）的卫星，算力大致相当于一整个数据中心机架。此次合作是谷歌“太阳捕手计划”的一部分，旨在探索太空 AI 数据中心的可能性。 今年 10 月，谷歌已部署了首颗 AI 服务器卫星，并成功启动了卫星搭载的 TPU。这颗卫星上运行的 Gemma 4 模型生成了一段俳句，并成功将其传回地球。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 19 that Google and Blue Origin have reached a partnership aimed at sending AI server satellites into space. According to IT之家, Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket will launch a satellite carrying Google TPUs (tensor processing units) in the first quarter of 2029, with computing power roughly equivalent to an entire data center rack. The partnership is part of Google's "Project Suncatcher," which explores the possibility of space-based AI data centers. In October this year, Google already deployed its first AI server satellite and successfully started the TPU aboard it; the Gemma 4 model running on the satellite generated a haiku and successfully transmitted it back to Earth.
items.why_zh: 推测：若计划如期推进，AI 算力基础设施可能向太空延伸，但相关细节来自二手报道，未见官方技术参数。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the plan proceeds on schedule, AI compute infrastructure could extend into space, but the details come from secondhand reporting and no official technical specifications were provided.

items.title_zh: 在线设计与出版工具 Canva 推出“AI 开关”，可关闭绝大部分 AI 工具
items.title_en: Canva launches an 'AI switch' that can turn off most AI tools
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，在线设计与出版工具 Canva（可画）今天宣布推出“AI 开关”，允许用户统一关闭或开启绝大多数 AI 工具， 免费版和 Pro 版用户均可使用 。 据介绍，该功能开启后可以移除绝大多数 AI 工具，但“背景移除”“魔法抓取”这类 AI 驱动的图像编辑工具依然会存在。 同时，用户还可在素材库中打开“减少 AI”，可降低搜索时看到 AI 生成图像的概率。 IT之家注意到，用户可在“个人资料”选项卡中调整这两项设置。如果要管理整个平台的 AI 功能，可以进入设置菜单中的“权限”，然后找到“启用生成式 AI 功能”。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 19 that online design and publishing tool Canva announced an "AI switch" that lets users turn most AI tools off or on at once, available to both free and Pro users. According to the company, enabling the feature removes most AI tools, but AI-powered image editing tools such as "background removal" and "magic grab" will still be present. Users can also turn on "reduce AI" in the asset library to lower the chance of seeing AI-generated images in search. IT之家 noted that users can adjust these two settings in the "Profile" tab; to manage AI features across an entire platform, administrators can go to "Permissions" in the settings menu and find "enable generative AI features."
items.why_zh: 推测：提供全局关闭 AI 的选项可能反映用户对 AI 生成内容与工作流渗透的顾虑，但未披露使用数据。
items.why_en: Speculation: offering a global AI off-switch may reflect user concerns about AI-generated content permeating workflows, though no usage data was disclosed.

items.title_zh: 这家气味初创公司称其 AI“鼻子”与人类一样灵敏
items.title_en: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
items.summary_zh: 在新泽西州纽瓦克机场附近的一间实验室里，约 30 名经验丰富的人类嗅辨员正逐一梳理地球上的各种气味。他们细致的记录——“坚果味”“桃子味”“海洋味”——会与化学分析交叉比对，为 AI 初创公司 Osmo 所称的全球首个气味基础模型构建丰富的训练数据。创始人 Alex Wiltschko 表示，公司的目标是“让计算机拥有嗅觉”。他说：“气味分子确实是这个星球上大多数物种唯一能说的语言。大多数物种无法通过声音或视觉交流，所以它确实是地球的原始语言。而且从记忆和情感的角度看，它对我们也极其强大。你闻过一次某种气味，可能一辈子都记得；你在街上闻到某种气味，可能就被拉回高中时代。”Wiltschko 声称，过去几个月 Osmo 的模型已达到“人类水平的嗅觉智能”。公司的定义是：该模型在识别和区分气味方面与普通人相当，在创造气味方面与初级香水设计师相当。公司称其技术已被用于香精行业，帮助品牌设计和制造新香氛。公司还称，上个月 Osmo 的 AI 模型在一家全球最大消费品公司中表现优于其内部调香师。Wiltschko 认为，该技术最终可能用于机场威胁检测或疾病诊断。Wiltschko 于 2023 年将这家初创公司从他此前在谷歌大脑（搜索巨头的前 AI 研究实验室）的工作中剥离出来，他正在沿用其他领域 AI 初创公司的打法：把大量数据投入难题，看看会发生什么。
items.summary_en: In a lab near Newark Airport in New Jersey, a team of around 30 experienced human sniffers are slowly working their way through every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation model for smell. The company’s goal, says founder Alex Wiltschko, is “to give computers a sense of smell.” “Scent molecules are really the only language most species on this planet can speak,” he says. “Most species can’t communicate with sound or visually, so it truly is Earth’s original language. And it’s incredibly powerful for us, from a memory and an emotional standpoint. You can smell something once and remember it for the rest of your life. You can smell something on the street and be pulled back to high school.” In the last few months, Wiltschko claims, Osmo’s model has achieved “human-level olfactory intelligence.” The company’s definition of this is that the model is about as good as the average person at detecting and discriminating between smells, and about as good as a junior perfume designer at creating them. It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents. Last month, the company says, Osmo’s AI model outperformed in-house perfumers at one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies. Wiltschko believes it could be deployed eventually for threat detection at airports, for example, or diagnosing diseases. items.title_en: Launch HN: Maritime (YC F26) – A managed cloud for production AI agents
items.summary_zh: 联合创始人 Ary 和 Maria 介绍 Maritime（https://maritime.sh），他们在构建一个“智能体原生”云，处理从自定义环境到 AI 智能体生命周期管理的一切。他们指出，旧金山涌现了大量沙盒（sandbox）公司，但沙盒最多只解决 AI 智能体基础设施问题的 10%；多数沙盒公司的做法是购买 Hetzner/OVH Cloud 裸金属服务器，用 Firecracker 切分成虚拟机后低毛利出售，这是对一个相当困难问题的狭窄解法。他们与数百家构建 AI 智能体的公司交流（从个人助理、编程智能体到医疗等垂直智能体），发现即使选定了沙盒供应商，仍必须自建额外基础设施才能跑通。主要摩擦点：1. 智能体生命周期管理——睡眠/唤醒、持久化存储、触发器、调度、按用户路由与支出上限、健康监控、故障恢复，以及向数千台虚拟机无停机部署更新，这些琐碎的沙盒管理任务都要企业自行构建与维护，累积起来成本很高；2. 自定义环境——生产环境智能体需求各异，有的需要 Windows 应用，有的需要 Android、带持久会话的浏览器、自定义操作系统镜像、预装桌面软件、特定依赖，还有的需要访问私有网络以与客户系统交互……
items.summary_en: Hi HN, we're Ary and Maria, co-founders of Maritime ( https://maritime.sh ). We're building an agent-native cloud that handles everything from custom environments to lifecycle management for AI agents. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lCWMdBQ96rY There’s been an explosion of sandbox companies coming out of SF, but sandboxes solve maybe 10% of the infrastructure problem for AI agents. The approach that most sandboxing companies take is: You buy Hetzner/OVH Cloud bare metal servers, use Firecracker to slice the servers up into VMs, sell those VMs with low margins. It’s a bit of an oversimplification, but the point is it’s a narrow solution to a fairly difficult problem. We talked to a couple hundred companies that are building AI agents. From personal assistants and coding agents to specialized healthcare agents, and the main pattern we saw was that even after choosing a sandbox provider, you still have to build additional infrastructure just to get things working. These were the primary points of friction: 1. Agent lifecycle management. There’s a lot that you have to build in order to properly give your agents VMs: things like sleep/wake, persistent storage, triggers, scheduling, per-user routing and spend caps, health monitoring, failure recovery, and deploying updates across thousands of VMs without downtime. There are so many of these small sandbox management tasks that companies have to build and maintain themselves, and they add up. 2. Custom environments. Production agents have varying needs. Some agents need Windows applications. Others need Android, browsers with persistent sessions, custom operating system images, preinstalled desktop software and applications, or specific dependencies. items.why_zh: 推测：若创始人的说法成立，AI 智能体基础设施的竞争点正从沙盒转向生命周期与环境管理；但这是创业公司的自述，未经独立验证。

items.title_zh: 微软官方 PyPI 包 Agent Framework 遭劫持，攻击者植入窃取登录凭据的恶意软件
items.title_en: Microsoft's official PyPI package Agent Framework hijacked, implanted with credential-stealing malware
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据科技媒体 TechRadar 今天报道，微软官方在 PyPI 发布的 Agent Framework 软件包遭黑客劫持，攻击者将其植入窃取登录凭据和云平台令牌的恶意软件。但幸运的是， 被植入恶意软件的版本仅存在 31 分钟就被删除 。 IT之家了解到，微软 Agent Framework Python 是一款开源工具包，每月下载量已接近 20 万次，可帮助开发者构建 AI 智能体，使其能够调用工具、遵循指令、与其他智能体交互，并执行更加复杂的任务。 11 月 17 日，黑客将 Agent Framework 劫持并发布 1.26.1 版本，其中的恶意软件会在 Python 启动时自动执行，即使运行环境并未导入 Agent Framework 软件包也不例外。 同时，该软件包旨在窃取 Azure、AWS、GitHub、Docker、Hugging Face、OpenAI 等服务的登录凭据，并获取本地配置文件和其他进程的信息。 PyPI 仅用 31 分钟就发现了此次入侵，并隔离了恶意版本。但两分钟以后，第二次攻击（1.26.2）接踵而至。新软件增加了 GitHub Actions OIDC 令牌请求功能，还能够自动搜索 GitHub Runner 目录，只不过发布 8 分钟后就被清除。 目前，我们尚不清楚此次攻击是否导致开发者信息泄露。如果您曾下载过 1.26.1 或 1.26.2，请立即删除，并仔细检查系统是否存在可疑文件、撤销现有登录凭据、检查 Azure 或 AWS 等服务是否存在未授权访问。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 19: According to tech media outlet TechRadar today, Microsoft's official Agent Framework package published on PyPI was hijacked by hackers, who implanted malware that steals login credentials and cloud platform tokens. Fortunately, the compromised version existed for only 31 minutes before being deleted. IT之家 notes that Microsoft Agent Framework Python is an open-source toolkit with nearly 200,000 monthly downloads that helps developers build AI agents able to call tools, follow instructions, interact with other agents and carry out more complex tasks. On Nov 17, hackers hijacked Agent Framework and released version 1.26.1, whose malware executes automatically when Python starts, even if the Agent Framework package is not imported in the runtime environment. The package is designed to steal credentials for services including Azure, AWS, GitHub, Docker, Hugging Face and OpenAI, and to obtain local configuration files and information from other processes. PyPI detected the intrusion in just 31 minutes and quarantined the malicious version. But two minutes later, a second attack (1.26.2) followed. The new package added a GitHub Actions OIDC token request capability and could automatically search GitHub Runner directories, but was removed 8 minutes after publication. It is not yet known whether the attack led to developer information leaks. If you have downloaded 1.26.1 or 1.26.2, delete it immediately, carefully check the system for suspicious files, revoke existing login credentials, and check services such as Azure or AWS for unauthorized access.
items.why_zh: 推测：此次事件显示针对AI开发工具链的供应链攻击可直接危及云与模型服务的凭据安全。
items.why_en: Speculative: the incident shows that supply-chain attacks on AI development toolchains can directly endanger credentials for cloud and model services.

items.title_zh: Audio Vivid 生态再进一步：理想汽车官宣上线菁彩声，支持声音对象精准空间定位与动态渲染
items.title_en: Audio Vivid ecosystem advances further: Li Auto announces rollout of Audio Vivid with precise spatial positioning and dynamic rendering of sound objects
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息， 理想汽车官方今日宣布上线菁彩声 Audio Vivid 。 据介绍，在今日的 2026 声音设计创新大赛启动现场，理想汽车联合产业伙伴官宣菁彩声 Audio Vivid 车载功能上线。 菁彩声 Audio Vivid 支持声音对象的精准空间定位与动态渲染 ，可让人声、乐器与环境音独立分布在不同方位、距离，声源位置随内容实时变化。 目前理想车机端网易云音乐、汽水音乐、喜马拉雅均已上线 Audio Vivid 内容。 IT之家注：菁彩声 Audio Vivid 是 UWA 联盟发布的三维声音频技术标准，是全球首个基于 AI 技术的音频编解码标准。该技术标准自 2022 年起已成功应用于总台春晚、奥运会、“九三阅兵”等大型活动直播。另外， 国家标准化管理委员会去年 8 月 29 日批准发布了三项数字媒体领域关键技术国家标准 ，包括： 《GB/T 46269.1-2025 高动态范围（HDR）视频技术第 1 部分：元数据及适配》 《GB/T 46269.2-2025 高动态范围（HDR）视频技术第 2 部分：应用指南》 《GB/T 46271-2025 信息技术三维声技术编码、分发与呈现》 此次发布的三项标准由全国音频、视频及多媒体系统与设备标准化技术委员会（SAC / TC 242）等单位牵头起草，于 2025 年 8 月 29 日正式发布，并将于 2026 年 3 月 1 日起实施，将对广播电视、互联网视听、消费电子等多个行业产生影响。 相关阅读： 《 菁彩影像 HDR Vivid、菁彩声 Audio Vivid 等三项国标发布 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 19: Li Auto officially announced today the rollout of Audio Vivid. According to the company, at today's launch event for the 2026 Sound Design Innovation Competition, Li Auto and industry partners announced the launch of the Audio Vivid in-car feature. Audio Vivid supports precise spatial positioning and dynamic rendering of sound objects, allowing vocals, instruments and ambient sounds to be distributed independently at different positions and distances, with sound-source positions changing in real time with the content. Currently, NetEase Cloud Music, Qishui Music and Ximalaya on Li Auto's in-car system have all made Audio Vivid content available. IT之家 note: Audio Vivid is a 3D audio technology standard released by the UWA Alliance and the world's first audio codec standard based on AI technology. Since 2022 it has been successfully used in live broadcasts of major events such as the CMG Spring Festival Gala, the Olympics and the "9·3 military parade." In addition, on Aug 29 last year the Standardization Administration of China approved and released three key national standards in the digital media field, including: GB/T 46269.1-2025 High Dynamic Range (HDR) Video Technology Part 1: Metadata and Adaptation; GB/T 46269.2-2025 High Dynamic Range (HDR) Video Technology Part 2: Application Guidelines; and GB/T 46271-2025 Information Technology — 3D Audio Technology — Coding, Distribution and Presentation. The three standards were drafted under the lead of the National Technical Committee 242 on Audio, Video and Multimedia Systems and Equipment (SAC/TC 242) and other units, officially released on Aug 29, 2025, and will take effect on March 1, 2026, affecting industries including broadcasting and television, internet audiovisual and consumer electronics. Related reading: "Three national standards including HDR Vivid and Audio Vivid released."

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息， 理想汽车官方今日宣布上线菁彩声 Audio Vivid 。 据介绍，在今日的 2026 声音设计创新大赛启动现场，理想汽车联合产业伙伴官宣菁彩声 Audio Vivid 车载功能上线。 菁彩声 Audio Vivid 支持声音对象的精准空间定位与动态渲染 ，可让人声、乐器与环境音独立分布在不同方位、距离，声源位置随内容实时变化。 目前理想车机端网易云音乐、汽水音乐、喜马拉雅均已上线 Audio Vivid 内容。 IT之家注：菁彩声 Audio Vivid 是 UWA 联盟发布的三维声音频技术标准，是全球首个基于 AI 技术的音频编解码标准。该技术标准自 2022 年起已成功应用于总台春晚、奥运会、“九三阅兵”等大型活动直播。另外， 国家标准化管理委员会去年 8 月 29 日批准发布了三项数字媒体领域关键技术国家标准 ，包括： 《GB/T 46269.1-2025 高动态范围（HDR）视频技术第 1 部分：元数据及适配》 《GB/T 46269.2-2025 高动态范围（HDR）视频技术第 2 部分：应用指南》 《GB/T 46271-2025 信息技术三维声技术编码、分发与呈现》 此次发布的三项标准由全国音频、视频及多媒体系统与设备标准化技术委员会（SAC / TC 242）等单位牵头起草，于 2025 年 8 月 29 日正式发布，并将于 2026 年 3 月 1 日起实施，将对广播电视、互联网视听、消费电子等多个行业产生影响。 相关阅读： 《 菁彩影像 HDR Vivid、菁彩声 Audio Vivid 等三项国标发布 》

items.title_zh: 华为官宣鸿蒙智行问界新 M8 搭载华为智擎增程五合一智能平台，综合发电效率 94.5%
items.title_en: Huawei announces Harmony Intelligent Mobility AITO New M8 with Huawei DriveONE five-in-one extended-range platform, 94.5% combined power-generation efficiency
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，华为电动技术有限公司官方账号 @华为智擎 今日宣布，鸿蒙智行问界新 M8 旗舰 SUV 搭载华为智擎增程五合一智能平台， 综合发电效率 94.5%，整车综合续航提升 2.8% 。 据介绍，华为智擎增程五合一智能平台的 P3 高速电机轮边最高转速 1850rpm， 可支撑整车达到最高时速 250km/h 。 参考IT之家此前报道， 鸿蒙智行问界新 M8 旗舰 SUV 已于 11 月 13 日正式上市 ，采用面向 L3 级自动驾驶架构设计，搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5、新一代全向立体融合感知系统，定价 37.98 万元起。 该车上市 72 小时，大定突破 11,000 台 。 延伸阅读 「华为智擎」是华为 HUAWEI DriveONE 的中文品牌，于 2026 年 4 月 22 日鸿蒙智行春季新品发布会上由华为常务董事、终端 BG 董事长余承东正式发布。它被定位为继鸿蒙座舱、乾崑智驾之后的「智能汽车第三大件」，与华为途灵平台、华为巨鲸电池共同构成智能汽车的核心技术底座。 华为智擎在 2026 年推出双 94% 碳化硅动力平台。其中增程平台搭载自研碳化硅模组、旋叠飞瀑式油冷技术、56 匝超高效电机及智能 AI 寻优算法，发电效率突破 94%，同样 50 升油量最多多发 6 度电；纯电平台则依托自研新一代 98.5% 高效同轴行星减速器、低粘度润滑油、0.15mm 超薄耐压绝缘系统及智能能量管理系统，工况效率同样超越 94%，100 度电最多多行驶 50 公里。 据官方数据，截至 2025 年底，华为智擎已连续 3 年在中高端新能源车型动力总成质量表现中排名第一，连续 2 年在国内 30 万元以上新能源汽车车型中动力总成发货量排名第一，累计发货量突破 240 万套，安全行驶总里程超过 400 亿公里。 问界新 M8 车身尺寸为 5190×1999×1795 毫米，轴距 3105 毫米，提供大五座和六座两种座椅布局。动力方面，纯电版搭载 800V 高压碳化硅平台，后驱长续航版 CLTC 续航达 705 公里，15 分钟可完成 30% 至 80% 补能；增程版则满足长途出行需求。 问界新 M8 以 15 亿元投入进行改款，共落地 126 项细节优化，其中不少调整来自 19 万老车主群体的 1000 多条建议。作为参考，老款问界 M8 在 19 个月里累计卖出 19 万台。 文中提及的华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 采用面向自动驾驶的 WEWA 2.0（World-End-to-End World-Aware）架构，是华为面向 L3 级自动驾驶设计的端到端感知决策一体化方案，基于华为自研的盘古大模型 3.0，支持无图城市领航，其无图方案已覆盖全国超过 300 个城市。 按照官方公布的信息，问界新 M8 全车共配备 38 个高精度传感器，其中包括 896 线双光路图像级激光雷达。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 19 that Huawei Electric Technology's official account @HuaweiDriveONE announced that the Harmony Intelligent Mobility AITO New M8 flagship SUV carries Huawei DriveONE's five-in-one extended-range intelligent platform, with 94.5% combined power-generation efficiency and a 2.8% increase in overall vehicle range. The platform's P3 high-speed motor reaches a maximum wheel-side speed of 1,850 rpm, supporting a top vehicle speed of 250 km/h. The New M8 launched on Nov 13 with an L3-oriented autonomous-driving architecture, Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 and a new omnidirectional stereo fusion perception system, priced from RMB 379,800; major orders exceeded 11,000 within 72 hours. The summary also describes the Huawei DriveONE brand background, dual-94% SiC powertrains, cumulative shipments exceeding 2.4 million units and over 40 billion km of safe driving by end-2025, as well as the vehicle's dimensions, powertrain options, RMB 1.5 billion facelift investment, 126 detail optimizations, 38 high-precision sensors and an 896-line dual-path image-grade lidar.
items.why_zh: 推测：若 94.5% 综合发电效率等数据经独立验证，可能强化华为在增程电动车动力平台上的技术卖点与竞争定位。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the 94.5% combined power-generation efficiency and related figures are independently verified, they could strengthen Huawei's technology pitch and competitive position in extended-range EV powertrains.

items.title_en: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
items.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划将 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元；这是一款带屏幕的小型设备，可让用户与 Muse AI 智能体对话。CEO 马克·扎克伯格今年早些时候公布了该设备，并表示公司预计在“12 月假日季前”出货，但当时未给出价格。扎克伯格在发布 Muse Charm 时表示，公司已把“完整的 Muse 体验”——包括实时语音与虚拟形象技术——装进这款设备。它配有指纹传感器，点击即可与 Muse AI 智能体对话，无需解锁手机或打开应用。……完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information . CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but he didn't provide a price at the time. When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had "packed the whole Muse experience," including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该定价属实，表明 Meta 试图用独立硬件承载 AI 智能体，而 300 美元价位将影响其消费级市场的接受度。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the reported price holds, it suggests Meta is betting on dedicated hardware to carry its AI agent, and a $300 price point would shape consumer adoption.
